title: BugFix FXIOS-15967 Reset settings stack on Deeplink

target.summary: Delegating to settingsViewController?.handle(route: .relayMask) does not present the Relay settings screen because SettingsViewController does not handle this route. As a result, selecting the Relay email mask option in settings has no effect.
notes: faulty statement delegating relayMask route to settingsViewController
